name: leung
about: 梁 (Leung, the Hong Kong Cantonese spelling of the surname Liang) as a neon sign, for the user, 2026-09-29. No small line. Strokes in the data's own order.

music.why: The Receptive's track (Analog Dreams, 90 bpm), the user's favourite of the first shorts; calm, for a sign that draws itself in
